notes.title: New Offline Mode!
notes.notes:
In January, we brought updated controls. Now in February, we have enabled an "Offline Mode" to allow players to still play local matches if there is no internet connection. Note: This will not save any data or progression.

Want to see something in our next update? Drop us a line, we love hearing your feedback!

notes.title: Mouse and Keyboard Update for Jan 4
notes.notes:
Howdy Folks and Happy New Year!
We have a few updates to ring in the new year: 

[list]
[*] updates to mouse direction aiming for character
[*] updates to more accurate mouse aiming
[*] updates to better keyboard bindings
[olist]
[*] Space Bar to skip intro and log in to Hub
[*] Space bar in menus to "accept"
[*] W/A/S/D to navigate menus
[*] W - Jump
[*] S - sprint
[*] A/D - move left/right
[*] C - crouch
[*] Escape - pause/exit a match
[*] Tab - view Xbox contol scheme
[*] Space - Dash
[*] 1 = canned message 1
[*] 2 = canned message 2
[*] 3 = canned message 3
[*] 4 = canned message 4
[/olist]
[/list]


In our next update, we plan to better support mouse with a cursor and have updated UI based on the controller/keyboard that is connected.

Please leave a comment below if you have any questions, comments or suggestions!

Thanks,
Mandy @ Black Hive Team

notes.title: New Keyboard/Mouse Controls in Queue
notes.notes:
Hi Folks, 
Currently, AlphaLink works best with an Xbox controller, but it does have a first pass of keyboard and mouse support.

Our first update will be better mouse and keyboard support, which is already underway. The image prompts and controller diagrams will also come with this update. 

Part of being on Steam Early Access is being able to take in feedback on what controllers we support next. So, if you have a favorite that you would like to see supported next, please drop us a line!
